Hand-made fixtures for scripts/fetch_planting_normals.py --selftest. The column
names follow NCEI's 1991-2020 normals naming (ANN-TMIN-PRBLST-T32FP10 and so on,
DLY-GRDD-TB5086-NORMAL); the numbers are invented for the arithmetic checks and
are not any real station. The workflow's probe run saves real CSVs to
data/planting-normals-raw/ (raw branch) so the layout can be checked.
